referenceEnglish: I advise you and myself to have God-consciousness.
notes: Common opening exhortation; keep the inclusive ‘you and myself’ meaning.

referenceEnglish: Indeed, faith is word and deed.
notes: Short doctrinal sentence; avoid expanding beyond the spoken text.

arabic: إنما المؤمنون إخوة، فأصلحوا بين أخويكم
referenceEnglish: The believers are but brothers, so reconcile between your brothers.
notes: Community-oriented phrasing; preserve the call to reconciliation.

arabic: قال الله تعالى: إن الله يأمر بالعدل والإحسان
referenceEnglish: Allah, Most High, says: Indeed, Allah commands justice and excellence.
notes: The quotation should be detected and verified against an approved source translation.

arabic: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: إنما الأعمال بالنيات
referenceEnglish: The Messenger of Allah, peace and blessings be upon him, said: Deeds are judged by intentions.
notes: Preserve the attribution and flag the source for verification.
